usage: app {--help | --version} [-n] [--normal=STRING] [--config=FILE] [--verbose] [--count=COUNT]
           [--output=<destination>] [--level[=NUMBER]] [--tag=TAG]

      --normal=STRING         
      --config=FILE           Loads configuration from FILEs
  -v, --verbose               Display verbose output
      --count=COUNT           Stop after COUNT items
      --output=<destination>  Write results to destination
      --level[=NUMBER]        Set the verbosity level
      --tag=TAG               Add TAG to the output
  -n                          Perform a dry run
  -h, --help                  Display this help screen then exit
      --version               Print the build version then exit
